ignore.*.stories.tsx: Stories repeat the same render shape by design.
ignore.*-fixtures.*: A fixture is plain data, repeated by design: each one states a component's whole props.
ignore.tests, mocks, e2e, tools: Not production logic; a new-clones-only gate for tests comes later.
ignore.tooling/oxlint/anti-slop: Vendored upstream code; tooling/oxlint/anti-slop/UPSTREAM.md records its source.
ignore.packages/kit/src/primitives/status/orb/e: Ported line for line from RareFormLabs/thinking-orbs (MIT); ADR-0017 keeps it diffable against the original.
ignore.packages/kit/src/symbols/svg-symbols: Tabler's MIT icon drawings (TABLER-LICENSE), kept as published; two glyphs share circles by design.
ignore.generated files: Fix the generator, not the output: *.gen.*, storybook.requires.ts, uniwind-types.d.ts, packages/db/drizzle.

reasons.baseline: The one entry in .jscpd-baseline.json is the Claude and Codex converter row helpers; each adapter keeps its own, and a shared helper would be shallow.
